title: Nik's Craftables - Music Discs
description: Adds crafting recipes for music discs.
body:
![purple text in the style of minecraft's logo that reads "CRAFTABLES"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eccdd03eda4eebaaf673eae9f78a289d03cc3314.png)

Adds crafting recipes for music discs. Why only have one craftable disc when they could **_ALL_** be craftable? Use flint to craft Disc 11 and use Disc 11 to craft all discs! Finally!! A use for flint!! Unlock all recipes by crafting a knowledge book.

## Knowledge Book Recipe
![craft a knowledge book with 1 book and 1 emerald](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d5b4a77a1353c0362196fcd23e7dbaea1fb016e.png)
